# Grain Detection Workflow

The grain detection method processes AFM height data through a sequence of image-processing steps.

The main stages are:

1. AFM data import
2. Laplacian convolution
3. Automatic thresholding
4. Small-component filtering
5. Skeletonization
6. Endpoint detection
7. Skeleton complementation
8. Bridge removal
9. Closed-cycle filtering
10. Grain identification
11. Border-grain removal
